limits.en: Up to 100 responses per month, 1 user, unlimited forms and questions with basic customization

keyLimits.en: 1,000 responses/month included, max 2,500/month; up to 3 users; removes Typeform branding, custom subdomain
10,000 responses/month included, max 50,000/month; up to 5 users; drop-off rates, conversion tracking, priority support
3,000 responses/month included; up to 3 users; video Q&A, multi-language support, AI clarification
Custom/unlimited responses; 6+ users with SSO, dedicated support, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, custom domains

cautions.en: There is also a separate 'Growth Flow' plan at $379/month ($266/month annual) with lead enrichment and Salesforce integration, positioned above Business rather than in the standard tier ladder.
Response limits are hard caps per plan; exceeding the included monthly responses requires an upgrade.

capabilities.en: Interactive, conversational online form and survey builder with conditional logic and AI-assisted form creation.
Response analytics including drop-off rates and conversion tracking on Business plan and above.

limitations.en: Free plan caps responses at 100/month, which is quickly exhausted for active forms.
Branding removal and custom subdomain require at least the Plus plan.

reason.en: Direct competitor form builder already flagged as a current alternative for Typeform.
Lightweight form builder competing on simplicity and lower cost.
Form and survey builder targeting the same conversational-form use case.

unknowns: Whether taxes are included in the listed USD prices is not stated on the pricing page.
